Name: Pirathon
Description: A town in Ephraim's hill country where Abdon son of Hillel, who judged Israel eight years, was buried, and the home of Benaiah the Pirathonite, one of David's mighty men and a commander of his monthly divisions.
BiblicalSignificance: Pirathon gave Israel a judge's grave and a king's commander: a hill town remembered through the men it raised.
RelatedPeople: Abdon, Son of Hillel; Benaiah the Pirathonite
